snapshots.consumer:

snapshots.contract: Inputs contain index and working arrays of {path, value}; value is valid or invalid. Both independent snapshots must be checked, including a staged record with no working representation. A repeated path in different snapshots is intentional; neither representation may replace the other.

boundary.base: export const inside = (root, target) => target === root || target.startsWith(root + '/');
boundary.benign: export const inside = (root, target) => target.startsWith(root + '/') || target === root;
boundary.consumer:
import { inside } from './target-guard.mjs';
export const evaluate = input => ({ allowed: inside(input.root, input.target) });
boundary.contract: Root and target are normalized absolute POSIX paths without trailing slash, dot or dot-dot segments. Allow only the exact root or its descendants. A sibling whose name begins with the root name is outside the root. No actual filesystem operation is performed by this example.

selection.contract: Inputs contain a files array of normalized repository-relative POSIX paths. Unit .test.mjs and .integration.test.mjs modules are persistent tests. Preserve input order. Non-test .mjs modules are not selected. This is fixture-only selection, not the source repository runner.
